name: Oslo
summary: Oslo is one of the most expensive capitals in Europe, but also one of the safest and with the best quality of life in the world. Surrounded by fjords and forests, it combines a vibrant cultural scene with a small but well-connected digital nomad community, thanks to ultra-fast internet and Nordic-quality coworking spaces.
